chords._schema: strings ordered low E (6) to high e (1). frets: null = muted/not played, 0 = open. fingers: 0 = open, 1 = index, 2 = middle, 3 = ring, 4 = pinky, null = muted.

easyC.name: C major (Lauren's 'easy C' — 2-finger reduction)
easyC.note: Reduced 2-finger C voicing for confidence-building. Spelling verified deterministically by chord-theory-check.js (2026-08-08) as C E G. 'Lauren's easy C' is a teaching label; arithmetic proves the fingering spells C major and is playable.

pivot_points.static_finger: none — both fingers lift and re-land (different frets)
pivot_points.movement: Em middle(2)/ring(3) on A/D 2nd fret -> easyC ring(3) on A 3rd fret + middle(2) on D 2nd fret; index not yet used.

exercises.name: Make easy C
exercises.purpose: Land the 2-finger reduction (ring on A 3rd, middle on D 2nd).

params.fingers: ring(3) on A-string 3rd fret, middle(2) on D-string 2nd fret
params.open_strings: low E, G, B, high e all ring

exercises.coaching: Easy C is just two fingers: ring on the A string third fret, middle on the D string second fret. The rest of the strings stay open and ring. Simpler than full C, same sound.

exercises.name: Your first song — Em to easy C
exercises.purpose: Loop the two chords slowly; aim for no stopping.

params.cue: one strum per chord, then switch

exercises.coaching: Here is your song: Em, strum. easy C, strum. Back to Em. Slow is fine — the goal is not stopping. You are literally playing a song right now.

avatar_coaching_copy.intro: Two chords and you can play a song. No joke. Today: easy C, then we loop it with Em. That loop IS a song.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex1_intro: Easy C is two fingers: ring on the A string third fret, middle on the D string second fret. Everything else stays open. Easier than the full C, same chord.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex2_intro: Now loop: Em (strum), easy C (strum), back to Em. Slow. The win is not stopping between them. You just played a song — tell your friends.
avatar_coaching_copy.results: If you can go Em-easyC-Em without a full stop, you have played a song. That is the retention hook — protect it.
avatar_coaching_copy.wrap: Two chords, one loop, a real song. Most apps make you wait weeks for this. You got it in Lesson 3. Practice the loop; Lesson 4 adds rhythm.
